'''Cookie''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]].

The Cookie recipe is normally obtained during [[Evelyn]]'s 4-heart event.  If, however, players experience a bug in which they view Evelyn's event but don't receive the recipe, it will be sold at [[The Stardrop Saloon]] for {{Price|300}}.

Cookies can be received as a gift from [[Evelyn]] at the [[Feast of the Winter Star]], and are rarely found in the [[Garbage Can]] outside [[1 River Road|George and Evelyn's home]] or outside the saloon.  Evelyn sells five Cookies in her [[Desert Festival]] [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|shop]] for {{Price|20|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s each. Cookies may randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]] or in [[the Stardrop Saloon]]'s rotating stock. One Cookie may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]]. If the player's character is male, after he earns {{Price|5000}} he will receive a [[Mom and Dad|letter from mom]] with cookies enclosed.

==Bundles==
Cookie is an option in the {{Bundle|Childrens||y}}.

==Tailoring==
Cookie is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create a [[Tailoring|Shirt]]. [[File:Shirt077.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
One Cookie may be requested by [[Blobfish]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 5 to 7.

==Notes==
[[Chocolate Cake]] uses the same ingredients as Cookies, but sells for more and is loved by [[Abigail]], [[Evelyn]], and [[Jodi]], and liked by [[Leah]], whereas Cookies are disliked by Leah and only liked by Abigail, Evelyn, and Jodi.
